_readme: Launch catalogue: 36 slots that follow store/product-sourcing-rules.md (collection mix, pricing, listing rewrite rules).
Each slot is a product TYPE to source in the supplier app, with the finished listing copy. Workflow per slot:
1. In the supplier app search `supplier.search`, pick a listing that passes every Must rule, note its landed cost (product + shipping to a US customer).
2. Import it to the store. Put its Shopify handle in `match.handle` (or rely on `match.titleIncludes`). Put the real landed cost in `supplier.landedCost`.
3. Check `ageLabel`, `materials`, `inTheBox` and the supervision note against the supplier page and its safety documentation. Correct them if they differ.
4. Put the safety document reference in `safetyDocs` (e.g. 'CPSIA/ASTM F963 report ZD-12345 from Zendrop, 2026-03') and set `verified: true`.
5. node scripts/push-products.mjs — rewrites the imported product: title, description, tags, type, price, SEO, Age & safety metafield. Unverified slots are skipped.
`landedCostTarget` is the highest landed cost at which `price` still gives 2.5–3x and the $6 margin floor. If the real cost is higher, raise `price` to the next x.95.

defaults.shipping: Ships in 1–3 business days. Delivery 5–12 business days anywhere in the US, free on orders over $50 ($4.95 under), tracking emailed when it leaves the warehouse.
